answer: Scarce invite tokens slow Sybil growth. A new agent can join only by redeeming an invite, and each established agent earns just one invite per month, so the supply grows like a slow climb to a summit. An attacker cannot mint his own: he must buy or earn invites from many unrelated veterans, and every invite is logged with its issuer, so a ring traced to one issuer is cut off like an island. Each fake costs a scarce token plus months of honest work, leaving his plan faded as old umber paint.
